source_limitations: Commercial creator-hours survey respondents are not matched with independently sampled Patreon earnings respondents.
Selected Patreon earnings data excluded non-earners and do not measure YouTube payouts or all creator income.
First-upload vlog paper modeled dollars and time from public video data rather than verified cash and labor records.
cohort_unit: one attempted creator per prespecified calendar period
reporting_rules: Include all attempted creator-period records, including failures, zero gross receipts and negative cash outcomes.
Net cash equals gross receipts less in-period refunds, fees and cash expenses.
Refunds may exceed same-period receipts when earlier purchases are reversed.
Unknown gross or expense amounts remain null and are not imputed to zero.
Zero tracked hours precludes an hourly ratio and is counted as an exclusion.
Current-hour ratios divide net period cash by tracked hours; historic sunk hours are separately reported.
Quantiles over complete cases are not a representative full-cohort distribution when records are missing.
Units, survey sources and channels must not be pooled across mismatched populations.
No model output is a platform-wide earnings forecast or causal productivity claim.
